blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Laguna Governor Sol Aragones became the subject of a graft complaint filed before the Office of the Ombudsman on Monday over alleged irregularities in a program which complainants said had a P11.5 million budget to provide free review center classes for civil service examination takers. According to Laguna Board Member Lorenzo Zuñiga Jr., one of the complainants, the program did not undergo a bidding process, other review centers offer the same services at a lower price, and some beneficiaries were allegedly told to submit fake documents. Aragones slammed the complaint, saying it was meant to destroy her reputation. In the […]... Keep on reading: Graft complaint filed vs Laguna governor over review class program
